# Raw 8-bit C1 bytes (0x80 to 0x9f), which aren't valid UTF-8. herdr 0.9.1
# shows each as U+FFFD and doesn't act on it, so what follows stays visible.
# Sightline does the same: it must not hide text the person can see, and the
# replacement characters are visible, so they're allowed.
# shown: SHOWN-osc
# shown: SHOWN-csi
# shown: SHOWN-dcs

Error: raw A\x85SHOWN-nel B
